payingUser: A solo general contractor, foreman or small-crew lead who writes a site daily report every working day and hates yearly construction-software subscriptions.
paidUnit: One-time unlock of unlimited multi-site daily logs with captioned photos and PDF/share export, with no ads and no renewal.
momentOfPayment: After the user finishes a free first-site daily report draft and taps Share or Export PDF — the moment the finished handoff would leave the phone.
distinctnessSentence: Crewday keeps an offline multi-site daily log with captioned photos per entry and a one-tap PDF/share handoff under a single unlock, instead of trapping the same job behind a yearly subscription or an enterprise construction suite.
day1RevenuePath: The listing targets the measured construction daily report query where Snappii apps show 50K+ installs with ads and IAP and Raken shows 100K+ with IAP; the first paid export of a multi-site captioned report is the visible unlock moment for $14.99.
assumptionsUnverified: Willingness to pay $14.99 one-time is inferred from $40/year subscription complaints and from IAP badges on 50K+/100K+ incumbents, not from this account's conversion data.
Enterprise suites (Raken, PlanRadar, Contractor Foreman) may absorb some discovery for the same query even when the product target is the weak mid-tier and solo users.
No trademark-register search has cleared the Crewday mark in class 9.
On-device PDF quality with many photos must be proven on mid-range phones; the market scan does not measure export performance.
